title: devbox.sh: Container Entry Script
description: Bash script to build and run the dev container with strict isolation, forwarding API keys and git identity.

steps.description: Usage: shebang, description, and usage examples for shell, opencode, omp.
Safety: set -euo pipefail for strict error handling.
Directory: cd to project folder using dirname.
Build: docker build -q -t cs357-devbox devbox with output suppressed.
API keys: loop through OPENROUTER, ANTHROPIC, OPENAI, CLOUDFLARE credentials and pass non-empty ones.
Isolation: read-only filesystem, tmpfs mounts, cap drop ALL, no new privileges, pids limit, memory limit, user mapping, git identity, volume mount.
